about: Daniel M. Reilly is an attorney who represents clients in the Denver, Colorado area. Daniel Reilly is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2006 - 2027. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

Daniel Reilly chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. He attended University of Denver Sturm College of Law and graduated in 1981. Daniel Reilly passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 1981.

He represents clients with Business Litigation issues in Colorado. He also represents clients with Estate & Trust Litigation, Intellectual Property Litigation and Personal Injury - General: Plaintiff issues.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, Daniel Reilly has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.
